user.title: ROI Tracker – add PV system
user.description: Calculates how much you save by using your own PV power and earn by feeding into the grid – and when the system has paid for itself. Calculated hourly from Home Assistant long-term statistics, also retroactively from the start date.

data_description.investment: Total cost of the system that should pay off.
data_description.start_date: Calculation starts on this day – also in the past, as far as HA has statistics.
data_description.price_sensor: E.g. Tibber, aWATTar or EPEX price. Unit €/kWh, ct/kWh or €/MWh is detected automatically. Prefer a sensor with long-term statistics (state_class); otherwise the retroactive calculation is only hourly-accurate for the last ~10 days.
data_description.price_fixed: Your energy price, e.g. 0.32. With a price sensor it is only used for periods without price data.
data_description.reward_fixed: E.g. 0.082 for 8.2 ct/kWh. 0 if you get no feed-in tariff.

sensors_house.title: Sensors: house consumption & grid import
sensors_house.description: Savings per hour = (house consumption − grid import) × price. A battery is automatically handled correctly. All sensors must be cumulative kWh meters (as in the energy dashboard).

data_description.consumption_sensor: Total power consumption of the house – from PV, battery or grid.
data_description.export_sensor: Energy fed into the grid (export meter). Optional – required for feed-in revenue. In the energy dashboard: Electricity grid → Return to grid.
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Energy bought from the grid – the import meter, NOT the export. In the energy dashboard: Electricity grid → Grid consumption.

sensors_pv.title: Sensors: PV production & export
sensors_pv.description: Self-consumption per hour = PV production − export + battery discharge − battery charge. All sensors must be cumulative kWh meters (as in the energy dashboard).

sensors_direct.title: Sensors: ready-made self-consumption
sensors_direct.description: For systems that measure self-consumption directly. Savings per hour = (self-consumption + battery discharge) × price.

data_description.consumption_sensor: PV power used directly – NOT house consumption and NOT grid import.
data_description.battery_discharge_sensor: Optional – only if self-consumption does NOT already include the battery.

error.price_required: Please enter a price sensor or a fixed electricity price.

error.duplicate_sensor: Each sensor may only be selected once.
error.battery_pair: Please provide battery charged and battery discharged together (or leave both empty).
